Pay the finite aligned 2+2+2 triangle while preserving linear-image-of-original-product provenance, or route the explicit heavy top-plane leverage / physical third-volume row anchor to an existing paid receiver. Arbitrary joint-density replacement is invalid by fleet04/B19 r4.
